input-field.name: enabled
input-field.label: Enable loyalty program
启用会员积分
input-field.helpText: When enabled, customers earn points and growth value for completed orders and can redeem points for a discount at checkout.
开启后，顾客在订单完成后可获得积分与成长值，并能在结算时使用积分抵扣。

input-field.name: pointsPerCurrencyUnit
input-field.label: Points earned per currency unit
每 1 个货币单位获得的积分
input-field.helpText: Number of points a customer earns per currency unit of the order total. The membership tier multiplier is applied on top of this value.
订单金额每满 1 个货币单位可获得的积分数。会员等级的积分倍率会在此基础再叠加。

input-field.name: growthPerCurrencyUnit
input-field.label: Growth value earned per currency unit
每 1 个货币单位获得的成长值
input-field.helpText: Growth value is used to determine the membership tier and is never spent or redeemed.
成长值用于评定会员等级，只增不减，不参与抵扣。

input-field.name: pointValueInCurrency
input-field.label: Currency value of one point
1 积分可抵扣的金额
input-field.helpText: Amount a single point is worth when redeeming points at checkout.
结算时 1 积分可抵扣的订单金额。

input-field.name: minRedeemablePoints
input-field.label: Minimum points per redemption
单次抵扣的最低积分
input-field.helpText: A customer must redeem at least this number of points in a single order.
单笔订单一次性使用的积分不得低于该数值。

input-field.name: maxRedeemablePercent
input-field.label: Maximum share of the order total payable with points (in %)
积分最多抵扣订单金额的百分比
input-field.helpText: Limits how much of the order total may be covered by redeemed points. Use 100 to allow paying the full order with points.
限制积分可抵扣的订单金额上限。填写 100 表示允许全额抵扣。

input-field.name: pointsValidityDays
input-field.label: Points validity in days
积分有效期（天）
input-field.helpText: Number of days after which awarded points expire. Enter 0 to make points valid indefinitely.
积分自获得之日起的有效天数。填写 0 表示积分永久有效。

input-field.name: tierAutoGroupSync
input-field.label: Sync customer group on tier upgrade
升级时同步客户群
input-field.helpText: When enabled, the customer group configured on the membership tier is assigned to the customer on every tier change. Leave disabled to manage customer groups manually.
开启后，会员等级变更时会自动把该等级绑定的客户群赋给客户。关闭时可自行维护客户群。
